The repair the refusal points to has a production caller: cli.case_repair calls CaseLog.drop_torn_entry, so the remedy works end to end (the gotcha 'done only when production code calls it').

claims.text: Repair refuses a log that is broken, not torn (a changed recorded entry is tampering): exit 3 naming entry 2, log bytes unchanged. It also refuses an intact log with exit 2 ('nothing is torn'), and a declined confirmation changes nothing (exit 1).

A failed packs-folder sync after the rename removes the unrecorded pack. A sign-off whose entry was not recorded is recorded once, and only under the name the pack carries.
